message: Astra: You wrote, “The relevance to the study needs to be clarified”; what connection can you actually support between Guangdong and your chosen memory-study conclusion? Within this analysis, is searching for that connection worth more time than attempting an English revision using the evidence already available? What unresolved uncertainty would instead justify staying with the question? Which available observation would help you decide? Could you now carry out your chosen step, rather than expand the plan again, and distinguish any finding from information you still lack?
